steps.say: Ines connects her Audiobookshelf server (the stub from LB1's quickstart, on 127.0.0.1:13378 with token demo-token). LB5 is an automation with no screen and no route: once a book is picked from this server (LB4's route, scripted in LB4's own try-it), the worker fetches its audio within one 30 s sweep and AudioFetched appears on the book's stream.
